purpose: Faculty can view their own ongoing and completed projects.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns one ongoing project and one completed project.
action_or_input: F1 requests their RSPC project list.
expected_result: Both the ongoing and the completed project owned by F1 are returned to F1.

purpose: Faculty can view the current status of their own project.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns a submitted project that is in a known workflow status.
action_or_input: F1 requests the details of that project.
expected_result: The response contains the project's current status, matching the status the project is actually in.

purpose: Faculty can view the history of their own project.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns a project that has gone through at least one lifecycle change after submission.
action_or_input: F1 requests the history of that project.
expected_result: The project's history is returned and includes the recorded lifecycle events of the project.

purpose: Faculty can view the approval history of their own project.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns a project on which at least one review/approval decision has been recorded.
action_or_input: F1 requests the approval history of that project.
expected_result: The approval history is returned and contains the recorded review/approval decision(s) for the project.

purpose: Faculty can view the audit trail of their own project.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns a project on which RSPC actions have been performed.
action_or_input: F1 requests the audit trail of that project.
expected_result: The audit trail entries for the project's recorded actions are returned to F1.

purpose: Faculty can view financial transaction records of their own project.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns a project that has at least one financial transaction record.
action_or_input: F1 requests the financial transaction records of that project.
expected_result: The project's financial transaction record(s) are returned to F1.

source_id: RSPC-CFR-001; RSPC-FR-004; RSPC-FR-005; RSPC-FR-006; RSPC-FR-107; RSPC-FR-108; RSPC-FR-109
purpose: Faculty access is scoped to their own projects; another Faculty member's project information is not exposed.
preconditions: Faculty users F1 and F2 each own a project; F2 has no other role on F1's project.
action_or_input: F2 requests their project list, and requests F1's project details/status, project history, approval history, audit trail and financial transaction records.
expected_result: F1's project does not appear in F2's project list, and F2's requests for F1's project information are denied or return none of F1's project information.

purpose: RSPC Admin can maintain structured records for audit and compliance.
preconditions: RSPC Admin user exists; an RSPC project record exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin creates/updates an audit/compliance record for the project.
expected_result: The structured audit/compliance record is persisted and can be retrieved with the entered values.

purpose: RSPC maintains logs of RSPC events for audit and compliance.
preconditions: Faculty user and a reviewer exist.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a research proposal and a reviewer records a review decision on it.
expected_result: A log entry is persisted for each action, identifying the action, the acting user and the time, and is retrievable by an authorized user.

purpose: HoD can review a faculty research-project request assigned to department-level review and evaluate departmental feasibility and alignment.
preconditions: A research proposal from a faculty member of HoD H's department is at the HoD review stage.
action_or_input: H retrieves the proposal and records a departmental feasibility evaluation and an alignment evaluation.
expected_result: H can view the proposal; the feasibility and alignment evaluations are persisted with the proposal.

purpose: HoD can record a departmental recommendation for a research proposal, and the proposal progresses according to it.
preconditions: A research proposal is at the HoD review stage.
action_or_input: HoD records a 'recommended' departmental recommendation with remarks.
expected_result: The recommendation is persisted on the proposal and the proposal moves to the RSPC Admin stage.

purpose: HoD can review a consultancy request, evaluate feasibility/alignment and record a departmental recommendation.
preconditions: A consultancy registration from a faculty member of HoD H's department is at the HoD review stage.
action_or_input: H retrieves the consultancy request, records feasibility and alignment evaluations and a 'recommended' recommendation.
expected_result: H can view the request; the evaluations and recommendation are persisted, and the request progresses to the next stage of the consultancy approval path.

purpose: Progression follows the HoD recommendation: a not-recommended request does not progress as recommended.
preconditions: A research proposal is at the HoD review stage.
action_or_input: HoD records a 'not recommended' departmental recommendation with remarks.
expected_result: The recommendation is persisted and the proposal does not advance to the RSPC Admin stage.

purpose: Dean-RSPC can review a research proposal routed for approval and approve it within the Dean's limits.
preconditions: A research proposal has been forwarded by RSPC Admin to the Dean-RSPC stage and does not require Director approval.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC retrieves the proposal and approves it with remarks.
expected_result: Dean-RSPC can view the proposal; the approval decision is recorded and the proposal status becomes approved.

purpose: Dean-RSPC can review a consultancy matter routed for approval.
preconditions: A consultancy registration has been routed to the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC retrieves the consultancy matter and records a review decision.
expected_result: Dean-RSPC can view the consultancy matter and the decision is persisted on it.

purpose: Dean-RSPC can forward a high-value or strategic request to the Director.
preconditions: A high-value or strategic research proposal is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC forwards the proposal to the Director.
expected_result: The proposal moves to the Director stage and the forwarding is recorded.

purpose: Dean-RSPC can review staff-appointment requests routed to the Dean-RSPC stage.
preconditions: A project staff-appointment request is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC retrieves the request and records a review decision.
expected_result: Dean-RSPC can view the request and the decision is persisted.

purpose: Dean-RSPC can review budget allocations routed to the Dean-RSPC stage.
preconditions: A budget allocation is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC retrieves the budget allocation and records a review decision.
expected_result: Dean-RSPC can view the budget allocation and the decision is persisted.

purpose: Dean-RSPC can review financial requests routed to the Dean-RSPC stage.
preconditions: A financial (fund/expenditure) request is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC retrieves the financial request and records a review decision.
expected_result: Dean-RSPC can view the financial request and the decision is persisted.

purpose: Dean-RSPC can review procurement requests routed to the Dean-RSPC stage.
preconditions: A procurement request is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC retrieves the procurement request and records a review decision.
expected_result: Dean-RSPC can view the procurement request and the decision is persisted.

purpose: Dean-RSPC can review project-closure records routed to the Dean-RSPC stage.
preconditions: A project-closure record is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC retrieves the closure record and records a review decision.
expected_result: Dean-RSPC can view the closure record and the decision is persisted.

purpose: Dean-RSPC can review compliance with represented institutional and funding-agency policies.
preconditions: A research proposal with represented institutional/funding-agency policy information is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC records a compliance review outcome for the proposal.
expected_result: The compliance review outcome is persisted with the proposal and retrievable.

purpose: Dean-RSPC approval is limited to requests within delegated or defined limits.
preconditions: A research proposal whose value exceeds the Dean-RSPC's delegated/defined limit (i.e. one requiring Director approval) is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC attempts to give final approval to the proposal.
expected_result: The proposal is not recorded as finally approved by Dean-RSPC; it remains requiring Director action.

purpose: Director can review a significant/high-value/strategic/escalated request routed to the Director stage.
preconditions: A research proposal has been forwarded by Dean-RSPC to the Director stage.
action_or_input: Director retrieves the proposal and approves it with remarks.
expected_result: Director can view the proposal; the Director decision is recorded and the proposal status becomes approved.

purpose: Director can approve large funding requests.
preconditions: A large funding request has been routed to the Director stage.
action_or_input: Director approves the funding request.
expected_result: The Director approval is recorded and the request status becomes approved.

purpose: Director can authorize high-value expenditures.
preconditions: A high-value expenditure request has been escalated to the Director stage.
action_or_input: Director authorizes the expenditure request.
expected_result: The Director authorization is recorded and the request status becomes approved.

purpose: Director can review adherence to represented institutional and external funding regulations.
preconditions: A request with represented regulation information is at the Director stage.
action_or_input: Director records a regulation-adherence review outcome for the request.
expected_result: The regulation-adherence review outcome is persisted with the request and retrievable.

source_id: RSPC-CFR-006; RSPC-FR-015; RSPC-FR-016; RSPC-FR-017; RSPC-FR-018; RSPC-FR-019; RSPC-FR-020
purpose: Faculty can submit a research project proposal capturing objectives, timeline, budget, funding source and resource requirements.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 exists.
action_or_input: F1 submits a research proposal with objectives, timeline, budget, funding source and resource requirements filled in.
expected_result: The proposal is created for F1 and the objectives, timeline, budget, funding source and resource requirements are persisted and returned unchanged when the proposal is retrieved.

purpose: A valid research proposal is routed from Faculty to the HoD stage.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 exists.
action_or_input: F1 submits a complete, valid research proposal.
expected_result: The proposal's status is the HoD review stage (pending HoD action).

purpose: A research proposal is routed through HoD, RSPC Admin, Dean-RSPC and Director in that order when Director approval is applicable.
preconditions: A valid research proposal requiring Director approval has been submitted.
action_or_input: HoD recommends; RSPC Admin forwards; Dean-RSPC forwards to Director; Director approves.
expected_result: After each action the proposal is at the next stage in order (RSPC Admin, Dean-RSPC, Director, approved) and each hand-off is recorded.

purpose: A proposal progresses only through the represented route; a later-stage actor cannot act before earlier stages.
preconditions: A research proposal is at the HoD review stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC (and RSPC Admin) attempts to approve/forward the proposal before HoD has acted.
expected_result: The attempt is rejected and the proposal remains at the HoD review stage.

purpose: Mandatory field validation is enforced for research proposals.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 exists.
action_or_input: F1 submits a research proposal with the mandatory proposal fields left empty.
expected_result: The submission is rejected with a validation error; no proposal is created or routed.

purpose: Policy validations represented as system validation are enforced for research proposals.
preconditions: A proposal policy is represented as a system validation.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a research proposal that violates the represented policy validation.
expected_result: The submission is rejected with a validation error; the proposal is not routed for review.

purpose: Proposal review/approval decisions are recorded with timestamps and remarks.
preconditions: A research proposal is at a review stage.
action_or_input: The stage reviewer records a decision with remarks.
expected_result: The persisted decision record includes the decision timestamp and the entered remarks and is retrievable.

source_id: RSPC-CFR-009; RSPC-FR-027; RSPC-FR-028; RSPC-FR-029; RSPC-FR-030; RSPC-FR-031; RSPC-FR-032
purpose: Faculty can register a consultancy project capturing client details, scope, deliverables, timelines and financial terms.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 exists.
action_or_input: F1 registers a consultancy project with client details, scope, deliverables, timelines and financial terms.
expected_result: The consultancy registration is created for F1 and all captured values are persisted and returned unchanged on retrieval.

purpose: Consultancy registrations are routed according to the represented institutional approval path.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 exists.
action_or_input: F1 registers a consultancy project.
expected_result: The registration enters the represented consultancy approval path at its first review stage and is not recorded as approved without passing through that path.

purpose: Consultancy payments and settlements are tracked as project records and form the consultancy financial history for authorized users.
preconditions: An approved consultancy project exists.
action_or_input: A consultancy payment record and a settlement record are recorded; the owning Faculty requests the consultancy financial history.
expected_result: Both the payment and the settlement are persisted and appear in the consultancy financial history returned to the authorized user.

purpose: Consultancy deliverables are tracked.
preconditions: An approved consultancy project with registered deliverables exists.
action_or_input: The status of a deliverable is updated and the consultancy deliverables are retrieved.
expected_result: The deliverable and its updated status are persisted and returned.

purpose: Consultancy approval history is maintained for authorized users.
preconditions: A consultancy project with at least one recorded approval decision exists.
action_or_input: The owning Faculty requests the consultancy approval history.
expected_result: The approval history containing the recorded decision(s) is returned.

purpose: Consultancy financial and approval history is available only to authorized users.
preconditions: A consultancy project owned by F1 with financial and approval history exists; user U has no authorization for it.
action_or_input: U requests the consultancy financial history and approval history.
expected_result: The requests are denied or return none of the consultancy's history.

purpose: Faculty can request a project-based staff appointment.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns an approved project.
action_or_input: F1 submits a project-based staff appointment request for the project.
expected_result: The staff appointment request is persisted for the project and retrievable.

purpose: RSPC Admin can manage advertisement and application records for project-based staff appointments.
preconditions: A project staff appointment request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin creates an advertisement record and records an application against it.
expected_result: The advertisement record and the application record are persisted, linked to the appointment request, and retrievable.

purpose: RSPC Admin can manage stipend structure and stipend-workflow records for project-based staff appointments.
preconditions: A project staff appointment request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a stipend structure and a stipend-workflow record for the appointment.
expected_result: Both records are persisted and retrievable for the appointment.

purpose: RSPC maintains appointment duration records for project-based staff.
preconditions: A project staff appointment exists.
action_or_input: The appointment duration is recorded.
expected_result: The duration record is persisted and retrievable for the appointment.

purpose: RSPC maintains payment records for project-based staff appointments.
preconditions: A project staff appointment exists.
action_or_input: A payment record for the appointment is recorded.
expected_result: The payment record is persisted and retrievable for the appointment.

purpose: RSPC maintains compliance records for project-based staff appointments.
preconditions: A project staff appointment exists.
action_or_input: A compliance record for the appointment is recorded.
expected_result: The compliance record is persisted and retrievable for the appointment.

purpose: RSPC Admin can maintain staff-selection records for project-based staff appointments.
preconditions: A project staff appointment request with applications exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a staff-selection record.
expected_result: The selection record is persisted and retrievable for the appointment.

purpose: Faculty can record participation in a staff selection process.
preconditions: A staff selection process exists for F1's project appointment requiring Faculty involvement.
action_or_input: F1 records participation in the selection process.
expected_result: F1's participation is persisted and retrievable on the selection process.

purpose: Faculty can submit a staff selection recommendation.
preconditions: A staff selection process exists for F1's project appointment requiring Faculty involvement.
action_or_input: F1 submits a selection recommendation.
expected_result: The recommendation is persisted and retrievable on the selection process.

purpose: Staff appointment approvals are routed through Dean-RSPC and Director as applicable.
preconditions: A staff appointment request requiring Director approval has completed RSPC Admin processing.
action_or_input: The request is forwarded for approval; Dean-RSPC acts, then Director acts.
expected_result: The request reaches the Dean-RSPC stage, then the Director stage, before being approved, and each hand-off is recorded.

purpose: Faculty can submit a fund utilization request.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns an approved project.
action_or_input: F1 submits a fund utilization request for the project.
expected_result: The fund utilization request is persisted and retrievable.

purpose: Faculty can submit an expenditure request.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns an approved project.
action_or_input: F1 submits an expenditure request for the project.
expected_result: The expenditure request is persisted and retrievable.

purpose: RSPC Admin can perform initial financial verification of a fund request.
preconditions: A submitted fund utilization request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records an initial financial verification outcome for the request.
expected_result: The verification outcome is persisted on the fund request.

purpose: RSPC Admin can perform initial financial verification of an expenditure request.
preconditions: A submitted expenditure request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records an initial financial verification outcome for the request.
expected_result: The verification outcome is persisted on the expenditure request.

purpose: Dean-RSPC can approve a financial request within delegated financial powers.
preconditions: A verified financial request within Dean-RSPC's delegated financial powers is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC approves the request.
expected_result: The approval is recorded and the request status becomes approved.

purpose: High-value financial requests are escalated to the Director.
preconditions: A verified high-value financial request (above Dean-RSPC delegated powers) is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: The request is processed at the Dean-RSPC stage.
expected_result: The request is escalated to the Director stage rather than being finally approved at Dean-RSPC, and the escalation is recorded.

purpose: Financial request, verification, approval, escalation and transaction-record information is logged.
preconditions: Faculty, RSPC Admin, Dean-RSPC and Director users exist.
action_or_input: A financial request is submitted, verified, escalated, approved, and a transaction record is created.
expected_result: Log entries exist for the request, verification, escalation, approval and transaction-record events and are retrievable for audit.

purpose: Faculty can request procurement of equipment.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns a project with a sanctioned budget.
action_or_input: F1 submits an equipment procurement request within the sanctioned budget.
expected_result: The equipment procurement request is persisted and retrievable.

purpose: Faculty can request procurement of consumables.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns a project with a sanctioned budget.
action_or_input: F1 submits a consumables procurement request within the sanctioned budget.
expected_result: The consumables procurement request is persisted and retrievable.

purpose: A procurement request within the sanctioned budget passes budget validation.
preconditions: A project with a represented sanctioned budget exists.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a procurement request whose amount is within the remaining sanctioned budget.
expected_result: The request is accepted and proceeds into the approval hierarchy.

purpose: A procurement request exceeding the sanctioned budget fails budget validation.
preconditions: A project with a represented sanctioned budget exists.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a procurement request whose amount exceeds the sanctioned budget.
expected_result: The request is rejected with a budget validation error and does not proceed for approval.

purpose: The approval hierarchy for procurement requests is enforced.
preconditions: A procurement request has been submitted and has not completed RSPC Admin verification.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC (or Director) attempts to approve the procurement request out of hierarchy order.
expected_result: The approval is rejected and the request status is unchanged.

purpose: Faculty can track procurement request status.
preconditions: F1 has submitted a procurement request that has moved past submission.
action_or_input: F1 requests the status of the procurement request.
expected_result: The request's current status is returned and reflects its latest stage.

purpose: Faculty can submit a periodic progress report.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns an ongoing project.
action_or_input: F1 submits a periodic progress report for the project.
expected_result: The progress report is persisted against the project and retrievable.

purpose: Faculty can submit a periodic utilization report.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns an ongoing project.
action_or_input: F1 submits a periodic utilization report for the project.
expected_result: The utilization report is persisted against the project and retrievable.

purpose: Reporting schedules represented from funding-agency norms are enforced.
preconditions: An ongoing project has a represented reporting schedule.
action_or_input: The reporting period defined by the schedule becomes due.
expected_result: RSPC records the report as due/pending for the project according to the represented schedule.

purpose: Authorized stakeholders can access historical progress and utilization reports throughout the project lifecycle.
preconditions: A project has earlier submitted progress and utilization reports and has since moved to a later lifecycle stage.
action_or_input: An authorized stakeholder (owning Faculty) requests the project's historical progress and utilization reports.
expected_result: All earlier progress and utilization reports are returned.

purpose: Historical progress and utilization reports are accessible only to authorized stakeholders.
preconditions: A project owned by F1 has progress and utilization reports; user U is not an authorized stakeholder of the project.
action_or_input: U requests the project's historical progress and utilization reports.
expected_result: The request is denied or returns none of the project's reports.

purpose: Faculty can submit a project closure report.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns an ongoing project.
action_or_input: F1 submits a project closure report.
expected_result: The closure report is persisted against the project and retrievable.

purpose: Faculty can submit a project completion report.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns an ongoing project.
action_or_input: F1 submits a project completion report.
expected_result: The completion report is persisted against the project and retrievable.

purpose: Verification of financial settlement is supported during project closure.
preconditions: A submitted project-closure record with financial settlement information exists.
action_or_input: The reviewer records verification of the financial settlement.
expected_result: The financial settlement verification outcome is persisted on the closure record.

purpose: Verification of asset declarations is supported during project closure.
preconditions: A submitted project-closure record with an asset declaration exists.
action_or_input: The reviewer records verification of the asset declaration.
expected_result: The asset declaration verification outcome is persisted on the closure record.

purpose: Project closure approvals and closure-related remarks are recorded.
preconditions: A verified project-closure record is at the approving stage.
action_or_input: The approving authority approves the closure with remarks.
expected_result: The closure approval and its remarks are persisted and retrievable.

purpose: Closed projects are archived with complete audit trails.
preconditions: A project has had its closure approved.
action_or_input: The archived project and its audit trail are retrieved.
expected_result: The project is in an archived/closed state and its complete audit trail (from submission through closure) is retained and retrievable.

purpose: Stakeholders are notified about proposal submission events.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 and the HoD of F1's department exist.
action_or_input: F1 submits a research proposal.
expected_result: A proposal-submission notification is created for the relevant stakeholder(s).

purpose: Relevant stakeholders are notified at applicable research-proposal review stages.
preconditions: A research proposal is at the HoD review stage.
action_or_input: HoD recommends the proposal so it moves to the next review stage.
expected_result: A notification is created for the relevant stakeholder(s) of the new review stage.

purpose: Stakeholders are notified about proposal approval events.
preconditions: A research proposal is at its final approving stage.
action_or_input: The approving authority approves the proposal.
expected_result: A proposal-approval notification is created for the relevant stakeholder(s), including the submitting Faculty.

purpose: Relevant stakeholders are notified about research-proposal rejection events.
preconditions: A research proposal is at a review stage.
action_or_input: The reviewer rejects the proposal.
expected_result: A proposal-rejection notification is created for the relevant stakeholder(s), including the submitting Faculty.

purpose: Stakeholders are notified about pending actions.
preconditions: An RSPC request is awaiting action by a stage actor.
action_or_input: The request enters the pending-action state for that actor.
expected_result: A pending-action notification is created for that actor.

purpose: Stakeholders are notified about escalations.
preconditions: A request is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: The request is escalated/forwarded to the Director.
expected_result: An escalation notification is created for the relevant stakeholder(s), including the Director.

purpose: Stakeholders are notified about reporting deadlines.
preconditions: A project has a represented reporting deadline approaching or reached.
action_or_input: The reporting-deadline notification trigger is evaluated.
expected_result: A reporting-deadline notification is created for the project's Faculty.

purpose: Reminders are sent for pending progress and utilization report submissions.
preconditions: A project has a pending (due, not submitted) progress report and a pending utilization report.
action_or_input: The pending-report reminder trigger is evaluated.
expected_result: A reminder is created for the pending progress report and a reminder is created for the pending utilization report.

purpose: Stakeholders are notified about financial approvals.
preconditions: A financial request is at its approving stage.
action_or_input: The approving authority approves the financial request.
expected_result: A financial-approval notification is created for the relevant stakeholder(s), including the requesting Faculty.

purpose: Stakeholders are notified about compliance requirements represented in RSPC.
preconditions: A compliance requirement is represented for a project.
action_or_input: The compliance-requirement notification trigger is evaluated.
expected_result: A compliance-requirement notification is created for the relevant stakeholder(s).

purpose: Notifications are delivered through Fusion dashboards.
preconditions: A research proposal has been submitted, generating a notification.
action_or_input: The recipient views their Fusion dashboard notifications.
expected_result: The RSPC notification appears in the recipient's Fusion dashboard notifications.

purpose: RSPC triggers system-generated email notifications.
preconditions: A notifiable RSPC event occurs (e.g. proposal submission).
action_or_input: The event is processed.
expected_result: A system-generated email notification is triggered for the relevant recipient.

purpose: Notification delivery infrastructure is external to RSPC while RSPC triggers notification events.
preconditions: A notifiable RSPC event occurs.
action_or_input: The event is processed.
expected_result: RSPC hands the notification event to the platform notification/email mechanism and does not itself own or operate delivery infrastructure.

purpose: RSPC exchanges, references or records workflow information through other Fusion modules where explicit integration is configured.
preconditions: An explicit integration with another Fusion module is configured.
action_or_input: An RSPC workflow event that the integration covers occurs.
expected_result: The relevant RSPC information is exchanged/recorded through the configured integration and the resulting record is retrievable.

purpose: Submission tracking information received from external funding-agency integrations is recorded.
preconditions: A project with an external funding-agency submission exists.
action_or_input: Submission tracking information is received from the funding-agency integration.
expected_result: The submission tracking information is persisted against the project and retrievable.

purpose: Disbursement tracking information received from external funding-agency integrations is recorded.
preconditions: A sanctioned project funded by an external agency exists.
action_or_input: Disbursement tracking information is received from the funding-agency integration.
expected_result: The disbursement tracking information is persisted against the project and retrievable.

purpose: RSPC does not own external funding-agency processes beyond submission/disbursement tracking records.
preconditions: RSPC module interfaces are available.
action_or_input: Inspect RSPC's available operations for external funding-agency processes.
expected_result: RSPC offers only recording/tracking of agency submission/disbursement status; no operation executes external agency submission, decision or disbursement.

purpose: Role-based access control is enforced for RSPC project data.
preconditions: An RSPC project exists; user U holds no RSPC role.
action_or_input: U requests RSPC project data.
expected_result: Access is denied and no project data is returned.

purpose: Users are restricted to actions permitted by their assigned RSPC roles.
preconditions: A research proposal is at the Dean-RSPC stage; Faculty user F1 holds only the Faculty role.
action_or_input: F1 attempts to perform the Dean-RSPC approval action on the proposal.
expected_result: The action is denied and the proposal status is unchanged.

purpose: RSPC does not own platform-wide authentication or RBAC administration.
preconditions: RSPC module interfaces are available.
action_or_input: Inspect RSPC's available operations for authentication and RBAC administration.
expected_result: RSPC offers no operation to authenticate users or administer platform-wide roles/permissions; it only applies RSPC role/action restrictions using supplied role information.

purpose: RSPC consumes role assignments from the Fusion role-management mechanism and they take effect immediately.
preconditions: User U has no RSPC role and is denied an RSPC role-restricted action.
action_or_input: The RSPC role required for that action is assigned to U through the Fusion role-management mechanism; U immediately retries the action.
expected_result: U is permitted to perform the action without any further step.

purpose: RSPC consumes role reassignments and they take effect immediately.
preconditions: User U holds RSPC role R1 and can perform an R1-only action.
action_or_input: U is reassigned from R1 to role R2 through the Fusion role-management mechanism; U immediately retries the R1-only action and an R2-only action.
expected_result: The R1-only action is denied and the R2-only action is permitted immediately.

purpose: RSPC role assignment and reassignment changes are logged.
preconditions: User U exists.
action_or_input: An RSPC role is assigned to U and later reassigned.
expected_result: A log entry exists for the assignment and a log entry exists for the reassignment, each retrievable.

purpose: RSPC does not perform HR/payroll processing for project staff appointments.
preconditions: A project staff appointment with payment-related records exists.
action_or_input: Inspect RSPC's available operations for project staff payroll/HR master data.
expected_result: RSPC offers no payroll execution or HR master-data operation; only appointment/payment-related records and statuses are available.

purpose: RSPC does not perform accounts payment execution for project finances.
preconditions: An approved financial request exists.
action_or_input: Inspect RSPC's available operations for payment/disbursement/ledger execution.
expected_result: RSPC offers no payment, disbursement or ledger execution; only request, approval, status and transaction-record tracking are available.

purpose: RSPC does not perform procurement execution or inventory stock operations.
preconditions: An approved procurement request exists.
action_or_input: Inspect RSPC's available operations for purchase execution, vendor management and stock operations.
expected_result: RSPC offers no purchase execution, vendor management or stock operation; only procurement request, approval and status tracking are available.

purpose: Faculty can update project details, milestones, progress and utilization information where the lifecycle permits.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns a project in a lifecycle state that permits updates (ongoing).
action_or_input: F1 updates the project details, a milestone, progress information and utilization information.
expected_result: Each update is accepted and the updated values are persisted and returned on retrieval.

purpose: Faculty updates are refused where the project lifecycle does not permit them.
preconditions: Faculty user F1 owns a project that is closed/archived.
action_or_input: F1 attempts to update the project details, a milestone, progress information and utilization information.
expected_result: Each update is rejected and the stored values are unchanged.

purpose: RSPC Admin can verify completeness of a submitted research-project proposal.
preconditions: A research proposal recommended by HoD is at the RSPC Admin stage.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a completeness verification outcome for the proposal.
expected_result: The completeness verification outcome is persisted on the proposal.

purpose: RSPC Admin can verify completeness of a submitted consultancy record.
preconditions: A consultancy record is at the RSPC Admin stage.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a completeness verification outcome for the consultancy record.
expected_result: The completeness verification outcome is persisted on the consultancy record.

purpose: RSPC Admin can verify completeness of a project-based staff-appointment request.
preconditions: A staff-appointment request is at the RSPC Admin stage.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a completeness verification outcome for the request.
expected_result: The completeness verification outcome is persisted on the request.

purpose: RSPC Admin can verify completeness of submitted fund-utilization and expenditure requests.
preconditions: A fund-utilization request and an expenditure request are at the RSPC Admin stage.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a completeness verification outcome for each request.
expected_result: The completeness verification outcome is persisted on each request.

purpose: RSPC Admin can verify completeness of a submitted procurement request.
preconditions: A procurement request is at the RSPC Admin stage.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a completeness verification outcome for the request.
expected_result: The completeness verification outcome is persisted on the request.

purpose: RSPC Admin can verify completeness of a submitted project-closure record.

purpose: RSPC Admin can check submitted records against configured/referenced institutional and funding-agency requirements.
preconditions: A research proposal is at the RSPC Admin stage; institutional/funding-agency requirements are configured or referenced for the process.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records the requirements-check outcome for the proposal.
expected_result: The requirements-check outcome is persisted on the proposal and retrievable.

purpose: RSPC Admin can forward an eligible request to the applicable approving authority.
preconditions: A complete, eligible research proposal is at the RSPC Admin stage.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin forwards the proposal.
expected_result: The proposal moves to the Dean-RSPC stage and the forwarding is recorded.

purpose: Only eligible requests are forwarded by RSPC Admin.
preconditions: A research proposal at the RSPC Admin stage has been found incomplete/ineligible by RSPC Admin verification.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin attempts to forward the proposal to Dean-RSPC.
expected_result: The proposal is not forwarded and does not reach the Dean-RSPC stage.
